arabic text: LAASHE PE ZAYNAB ROKE PUKAARI,\nBHAYYA HUMAARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: AT THE DEAD BODY, ZAINAB CRIED\nAND SAID 'BROTHER, WE HAVE NO ONE!'

arabic text: KHAIME JHALE AUR SAJJAD QAIDI,\nKAFNI TUMHARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: THE TENTS BURNED AND SAJJAD IS PRISONER, THERE\nIS NO ONE TO GIVE YOU KAFAN

arabic text: DEKHO AY BHAI ME ZAHRA KI JAAYI
english translation text: LOOK AT ME OH BROTHER, ZAHRA’S DAUGHTER

arabic text: LAASHE PE AAYI HU BE PARDA HOKAR
english translation text: I HAVE COME TO YOUR BODY WITHOUT HIJAB

arabic text: MAARA GAYA HAY ABBAS GHAAZI,\nQASSIM DULAARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: ABBAS HAS DIED,\nQASSIM IS NO MORE

arabic text: BEKAS YATIMO KA KAFELA, BHAI
english translation text: THIS CARAVAN OF HELPLESS ORPHANS, OH BROTHER

arabic text: TUHI BATAADE KE KAHAA LEKE JAAWU
english translation text: YOU TELL ME, WHERE I SHOULD TAKE THEM?

arabic text: LAASHE SAMBHAALUN YA KUMBE KO DEKHU, GHAM KA KINAARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: SHOULD I TAKE CARE OF THE DEAD BODIES, OR WATCH OVER THE CLAN? THERE IS NO ONE TO SHARE MY GRIEF

arabic text: WIRAA HAY KHAIME, KHAALI HAY JHULA
english translation text: THE TENTS ARE DESERTED, THE CRADLE IS EMPTY

arabic text: TISHNA SAKINA KE QISSE KO DEKHO
english translation text: LOOK AT THE STORY OF YOUR BELOVED SAKINA

arabic text: GIR KAR HUWI CHOT BE AAS BETI,\nAB TO SAHAARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: SAKINA IS INJURED FROM FALLING,\nNOW THERE IS NO SUPPORT

arabic text: KARIYAL JAWAAN KI MAYYAT HAY AAYI
english translation text: THE YOUTH’S DEAD BODY HAS COME

arabic text: KEHTI HAY LAILA ‘AY MERE AKBER’
english translation text: LAILA SAYS, 'OH MY AKBAR!'

arabic text: KISKI NAZAR TUMKO KHAA GAYI BETA, MERA SAHAARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: WHOSE EVIL LOOK HAS DONE THIS TO YOU SON, I HAVE NO SUPPORT

arabic text: BOLI YUN RO KE ZAHRA KI JAAYI
english translation text: ZAHRA’S DAUGHTER CRIED AND SAID,

arabic text: KARBALA ME GHAR LUT GAYA HAY
english translation text: MY HOME HAS BEEN ROBBED IN KARBALA

arabic text: MAARA GAYA HAY AB MERA BHAAI, WAARIS HAMARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: NOW MY BROTHER IS DEAD, WE HAVE NO ONE TO PROTECT US

arabic text: BOLI YE ZAINAB ‘AUNO MUHAMMAD’
english translation text: ZAINAB SAID, 'AUN AND MUHAMMAD'

arabic text: UTHO AY PYAARO AAYI HAY MAADAR
english translation text: WAKE UP MY BELOVED SONS, YOUR MOTHER HAS COME

arabic text: BAATE TO KARLO, BOLO AY PYAARO,\nGHAM KA KINAARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: TALK TO ME OH MY BELOVEDS, THERE\nIS NO ONE TO SHARE MY GRIEF

arabic text: TIIR SE MAARA ASGHARE BESHEER
english translation text: THEY KILLED ASGHAR WITH AN ARROW

arabic text: PAANI NA PAAYA HAAY WHO BACHAA
english translation text: THE CHILD COULD NOT GET ANY WATER

arabic text: AAWO AY BETA KHAALI HAY JHULA,\nJHULNE WAALA KOI NAHI
english translation text: COME, OH SON, THE CRADLE IS EMPTY, THERE\nIS NO ONE TO SWING THE CRADLE

arabic text: GHAM KI KAHAANI KISKO SUNAAWU
english translation text: WHO SHOULD I TELL THIS STORY OF GRIEF

arabic text: BHAYYA HAMMARA TUM BHI CHALE
english translation text: OH MY BROTHER, YOU HAVE LEFT

arabic text: SAJJAD BIMAAR HUM HAY QAIDI, WARIS HAMAARA KOI NAHI
english translation text: SAJJAD IS SICK AND WE ARE PRISONERS, WE HAVE NO ONE TO PROTECT US

arabic text: KARBALA ME HUMKO BULAANA
english translation text: CALL US TO KARBALA

arabic text: AAKE WAHAA HUM PARLE ZIYAARAT
english translation text: WE WILL COME AND RECITE ZIYARRAT

arabic text: MERI TAMANNA AAWU WAHAA ME,\nISKE SIWAA KOI AARZOO NAHIN
english translation text: MY WISH IS TO GO THERE, OTHER\nTHAN THIS I HAVE NO OTHER WISH
